summary: Alibaba Group filed a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) attaching a press release announcing its June quarter 2026 results. Revenue reached RMB268,953 million (US$39,639 million), up 9% year-over-year, while net income fell 75% to RMB10,444 million and non-GAAP net income fell 38% to RMB20,715 million. Alibaba Cloud external revenue grew 45%, with AI-related product revenue posting triple-digit growth for a twelfth consecutive quarter. Free cash flow was an outflow of RMB44,670 million on cloud infrastructure spending. This is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation.
